e0_surface_contract.max_new_tokens_derivation: per checkpoint, the longest frozen legal answer surface plus the registered termination margin

frozen_project_decisions.decision: D0_single_forward_decodability is a conditional diagnostic only. It is never an RP-B gate and never qualifies a candidate.
frozen_project_decisions.title: D0 is a conditional diagnostic only

frozen_project_decisions.decision: The natural RP-B ladder has fixed membership and fixed order with L = 3: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, ordered by parameter count ascending. There is no fallback candidate and no post-result expansion.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Fixed RP-B ladder, L = 3

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Immutable checkpoint revisions must be resolved and sealed before protocol freeze.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Checkpoint revisions sealed before freeze

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Q0 uses E0 as its primary gate, item-disjoint development and confirmation sets, first-confirmed-pass selection, and multiplicity correction over the full registered L = 3.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Q0 structure and multiplicity

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Wrapper qualification remains a two-arm joint-adequacy gate. Both arms must be represented in the atomic-cell census and in the multiplicity calculation. The author may not reuse m_max = 43 without independently re-deriving it.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Two-arm wrapper joint adequacy enters the census

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Wrapper bytes, roles, separators, BOS/EOS behavior, answer cues, few-shot examples and template revisions must be frozen exactly.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Wrapper bytes frozen exactly

frozen_project_decisions.decision: The negative control must use an executable one-sided upper-bound or equivalence design with a registered unit, chance level, margin, sample size, alpha, exact construction and multiplicity family.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Executable negative-control design

frozen_project_decisions.decision: E0 legal answer surfaces and token sequences are checkpoint-revision-specific. max_new_tokens is derived per checkpoint as the longest frozen legal answer surface plus the registered termination margin. The universal value 3 is not inherited.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Per-checkpoint answer surfaces and generation length

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Tokenizer-functional inequality creates an explicitly separate isomorphic-reinstantiation stratum and may never be pooled as the same frozen interface.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Isomorphic-reinstantiation stratum is separate

frozen_project_decisions.decision: The generated-CoT ceiling is a per-checkpoint execution precondition with k = 1 and a frozen task population, bank relationship, parser, context and generation bound, and total resource bound. It is not an interface selector.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Generated-CoT ceiling is a bounded execution precondition

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Study 3R covers behavioral and interface qualification only.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Scope is behavioral and interface qualification

frozen_project_decisions.decision: RP-M, activation patching and mechanism claims are outside Study 3R and are not authorized. They may be considered later as a separate Study 3M, only after all Study 3R gates pass.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Mechanism work is out of scope

frozen_project_decisions.decision: The Study 3R state machine, schema, registry, statistics, manifest generator and semantic tests must be written cleanly from scratch. The legacy 40-key protocol structure is not carried forward.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Clean-room authoring, no legacy structure

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Every decision-bearing schema field must be constrained. Validation must include coordinated generator-mutation tests, not only artifact-versus-generator byte equality.
frozen_project_decisions.title: Constrained schemas and coordinated mutation testing

frozen_project_decisions.decision: Study 3R receives one protocol-authoring session and one independent focused review. If that review returns any BLOCKING finding, Study 3R terminates and no automatic amendment follows.
frozen_project_decisions.title: One authoring session and one review

out_of_scope.may_be_considered_later_as: Study 3M, only after all Study 3R gates pass

study_identity.name: Study 3R
study_identity.relationship_to_predecessor: clean-room successor; no protocol text, structure, schema, registry, statistics, manifest generator or test is carried forward
